row: In WinRecovery we offer physiotherapy services for animals, specially high level sport horses in all disciplines. We mainly use electrotherapy, Tecartherapy (TECAR: Transfer of electricity capacitive resistive), non invasive, painless technique using electrodes on the horse body. It speeds up the process of natural healing, working on a wide variety of injuries in all type of tissues (muscle, tendon, ligaments, joints, bones).
